title: auth-stack - request flow
description: One request, every hop: Traefik at the edge, the frontend, the frontend -> backend hop, the backend and its database hop, plus the module branch the backend opens for module assignments (backend -> module service -> its MySQL), each measured by the component that owns it with the same histogram buckets. Rate, p95 and failure share per hop side by side, the per-hop latency lines that show where time is spent, and the routes seen at every hop.

options.content:
**Traefik (edge)** → **auth-portal** (frontend, Go server) → *frontend → backend hop* → **user-mgmt-service** (backend, Spring Boot) → *backend → database hop* (HikariCP pool, Spring Data repositories) → **managed PostgreSQL**

One column per hop, left to right in the order a request travels. Every hop is measured by the component that owns it: the edge by Traefik's service metrics (service label = `<namespace>-<service>-<port>`), the two servers by their `http_server_requests_seconds` histograms, the frontend → backend hop by the frontend's `http_client_requests_seconds` (peer = backend), the database hop by the backend's repository invocation histogram. Same histogram buckets everywhere, so the p95 values are comparable.

panels.title: Latency (p95) by hop
panels.description: The same request measured at every hop: the outer lines include everything inside them, so the vertical gap between two lines is the time spent in the component between them. The module branch (backend -> module service -> MySQL) only carries the module endpoints, so its lines sit apart from the main flow.

panels.title: Where the time goes (p95, now)
panels.description: The p95 per hop as a bar, outer hops first; a bar much longer than the next one inward marks the component that adds the time.

panels.title: Request rate by hop
panels.description: Requests per second at every hop. Edge > frontend means Traefik answered some requests itself (redirects, TLS challenges); frontend > client hop is the share served without the backend (pages, static files); one backend call per proxied request otherwise. Client hop > module service means retries (or a circuit breaker that opened after failures).

panels.title: Failure share by hop
panels.description: Where failures originate: the innermost hop that shows them is the one producing them; the hops outside only relay.

targets.expr: 100 * sum (rate(http_client_requests_seconds_count{namespace=~"$namespace", job="frontend", peer="backend", outcome=~"SERVER_ERROR|UNKNOWN"}[5m])) / sum (rate(http_client_requests_seconds_count{namespace=~"$namespace", job="frontend", peer="backend"}[5m]))

100 * sum (rate(http_client_requests_seconds_count{namespace=~"$namespace", job="backend", peer="modules", outcome=~"SERVER_ERROR|UNKNOWN"}[5m])) / sum (rate(http_client_requests_seconds_count{namespace=~"$namespace", job="backend", peer="modules"}[5m]))

panels.description: The hop between the pods, by the backend's route template as the frontend sees it.

targets.expr: 100 * sum by (uri) (rate(http_client_requests_seconds_count{namespace=~"$namespace", job="frontend", peer="backend", outcome=~"SERVER_ERROR|UNKNOWN"}[5m])) / sum by (uri) (rate(http_client_requests_seconds_count{namespace=~"$namespace", job="frontend", peer="backend"}[5m]))
histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, uri) (rate(http_client_requests_seconds_bucket{namespace=~"$namespace", job="frontend", peer="backend"}[5m])))

targets.expr: 100 * sum by (method) (rate(spring_data_repository_invocations_seconds_count{namespace=~"$namespace", job="backend", state="ERROR"}[5m])) / sum by (method) (rate(spring_data_repository_invocations_seconds_count{namespace=~"$namespace", job="backend"}[5m]))
